blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Vice President Sara Duterte is “the last person” who should ask President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. to resign because of a “conflict of interest,” Lanao del Sur Rep. Zia Alonto Adiong said Thursday. Adiong explained that this was clearly a conflict of interest on Duterte’s part, as she is the main person who would stand to benefit from Marcos’ resignation. She also announced her plans to run for president in the 2028 elections.
